skill.name: agentic-wallet
skill.description: Operate an agentic crypto wallet with the awal CLI for authentication, balances, transfers, trades, funding, x402 payments, API monetization, and Base onchain queries.
skill.summary: Guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through awal wallet and x402 payment workflows.
skill.author: internet-court

security_audit.summary: The reviewed files describe a legitimate Coinbase awal wallet skill, not malware or prompt injection. The main risks are intentional: external CLI execution, real crypto transfers and swaps, automatic x402 payments, and sensitive wallet authentication and API secret handling.

remediation.issue: Transfers, swaps, and x402 payments can spend real user funds.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user confirmation of amount, asset, network, recipient or endpoint, and maximum payment before executing any spend command.

remediation.issue: x402 payments can call arbitrary external URLs.
remediation.suggestion: Validate URLs strictly, inspect payment requirements first, and require a max payment for every paid request.

remediation.issue: Wallet authentication uses sensitive email and OTP values.
remediation.suggestion: Keep OTP entry human-mediated and avoid storing, logging, or reusing OTP values after verification.

remediation.issue: Production x402 facilitator setup uses CDP API secrets.
remediation.suggestion: Use least-privilege CDP keys, keep secrets outside prompts and generated files, and document secure environment setup.

remediation.issue: The skill runs npm, npx, node, curl, and wallet commands.
remediation.suggestion: Pin package versions, keep argument allowlists, and reject shell metacharacters before command construction.

content.value_statement: Wallet and x402 workflows are risky to run from memory. This skill gives structured CLI steps for balances, transfers, trades, funding, paid API calls, and x402 services.
actual_capabilities: Checks wallet authentication state and routes users through sign-in when needed.
Reads balances and wallet addresses across Base, Polygon, and Solana.
Guides USDC, ETH, POL, and SOL transfers with input validation rules.
Guides token swaps on Base and Polygon with amount and slippage guidance.
Discovers, inspects, and pays x402 API endpoints with USDC on Base.
Documents x402 API monetization and paid Base onchain SQL queries.
limitations: Requires the awal CLI through npx and an available wallet companion session.
Can perform real financial actions, so users must confirm amounts and recipients.
Supports only the documented chains, assets, and x402 workflows.
Cannot sign out programmatically; sign-out requires the wallet companion UI.

use_cases.title: Check Wallet Readiness
use_cases.description: Confirm authentication, wallet address, and spendable balances before a transfer, swap, or paid API call.

use_cases.title: Move Or Swap Funds
use_cases.description: Prepare validated commands for USDC transfers or token swaps on supported chains.

use_cases.title: Build Paid API Workflows
use_cases.description: Discover x402 services, call paid endpoints, or create an Express server that charges per request.

prompt_templates.title: Check Balance
prompt_templates.prompt: Check my wallet status and show my Base USDC balance. Ask before running any command that changes funds.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare A Transfer
prompt_templates.prompt: Send 1 USDC on Base to this recipient after validating the address and showing the exact amount, asset, network, and recipient.

prompt_templates.title: Evaluate A Paid API
prompt_templates.prompt: Find x402 weather APIs under 0.05 USD, inspect payment requirements, and recommend one before making any payment.

prompt_templates.title: Create Paid Endpoint
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an Express x402 payment server that charges 0.01 USD for GET /api/example and includes discovery metadata.

output_examples.input: Check my wallet balance on Base.
output: Base USDC and ETH balances are summarized for the user.
Funding guidance is provided if the spendable balance is low.

output_examples.input: Pay an x402 API with a maximum cost of 0.10 USD.
output: The endpoint URL and maximum payment are validated.
The wallet balance is checked before payment.
The result includes the endpoint response and the paid amount.

output_examples.input: Help me monetize an API with x402.
output: The wallet payment address is identified.
The protected route, price, network, and discovery metadata are planned.
Testing steps are provided for unpaid and paid requests.

best_practices: Confirm amount, asset, network, recipient, and maximum payment before any spend.
Validate every user-provided address, URL, amount, and JSON body before command construction.
Use JSON output for balances and payment results when downstream parsing is needed.
anti_patterns: Do not run transfers, swaps, or x402 payments from ambiguous user requests.
Do not pass unvalidated user input into shell commands.
Do not treat formatted balances as atomic units for payments or transfers.

faq.answer: Yes. It uses the awal CLI, so transfers, swaps, and x402 payments can spend real funds.

faq.question: Which chains are documented?
faq.answer: The references cover Base, Polygon, Solana, Base Sepolia, and Solana Devnet for supported operations.

faq.question: Can it send tokens to ENS names?
faq.answer: Yes. The send workflow supports valid Ethereum addresses, ENS names, and Solana addresses.

faq.question: Can it pay arbitrary x402 services?
faq.answer: It can inspect and pay x402 endpoints when the URL is valid and the wallet has enough USDC.

faq.question: Does it include API monetization guidance?
faq.answer: Yes. It documents an Express server pattern that charges USDC through x402 middleware.

faq.question: What should users confirm before payments?
faq.answer: Users should confirm the endpoint, amount, maximum payment, chain, recipient, and expected result.
